e35b582efe3e4d26.description: Job Title: Director, Cloud, Connectivity & OT Reporting To: CTO Business Unit / Function: Technology & Innovation Department: Cloud, Connectivity & Operational Technology Grade: M13 Position Type: Regular Why This Role Matters The Director, Cloud, Connectivity & OT shapes the technology foundations that enable secure, resilient and increasingly connected industrial operations across Ma aden. The role sets the enterprise direction for operational technology, connectivity, cloud and edge environments, creating a consistent digital backbone between plant systems, production environments and enterprise technology. The role creates value by improving the reliability, scalability and maturity of industrial technology while enabling automation, real-time operational insight and data-driven decision-making. It strengthens the convergence of OT and IT while ensuring architecture, platforms and technology investments remain aligned with operational priorities and enterprise standards. Through enterprise governance, modernization and capability building, the role enables Ma aden to scale digital and autonomous operations while strengthening operational resilience and managing industrial technology risk. What You Will Deliver Enterprise OT, Cloud & Connectivity Strategy Shape and execute the enterprise strategy and roadmap for OT architecture, cloud, edge, connectivity and industrial technology, aligned with enterprise architecture and technology priorities. Establish standards, governance and lifecycle principles that create consistent, scalable and resilient industrial technology environments across sites. Translate operational priorities and technology maturity gaps into targeted transformation initiatives with clear performance outcomes. Resilient Industrial Technology Drive the modernization and standardization of critical OT systems and controls, including PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, LIMS and historian environments. Strengthen the availability, reliability, interoperability and lifecycle performance of technology supporting mining and processing operations. Enable resilient cloud, edge, hosting and connectivity environments that provide dependable data exchange across industrial and enterprise systems. Digital & Operational Enablement Build the technology foundations required to scale automation, advanced analytics, remote operations and increasingly autonomous operating models. Enable secure, reliable and high-quality OT data flows into enterprise, cloud and Data & AI environments. Improve operational visibility and technology performance through remote monitoring, optimization and proactive management of industrial systems. Governance, Risk & Transformation Strengthen OT governance, architecture and controls to manage technology risk, cybersecurity dependencies, obsolescence and lifecycle requirements. Direct enterprise modernization initiatives that improve technology maturity, operational resilience and scalability across sites. Establish meaningful KPIs for OT availability, reliability, resilience and maturity, using performance insights to prioritize investment and improvement. Enterprise & People Leadership Align Operations, IT, Data & AI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity and Innovation around integrated technology roadmaps and transformation priorities. Lead and develop multidisciplinary capability across OT architecture, infrastructure, connectivity and related technology disciplines. Provide authoritative advice to executive stakeholders and strengthen decision-making on industrial technology priorities, investments, risks and strategic partnerships. What Success Looks Like Enterprise OT, cloud, connectivity and edge architectures are standardized and adopted across relevant operations. Critical industrial technology environments achieve targeted levels of availability, reliability, resilience and scalability. Technology modernization delivers measurable improvements in operational performance, automation readiness and technology maturity. OT and enterprise technology environments exchange secure, reliable and high-quality data that enables analytics, automation and operational decision-making. Industrial technology, cybersecurity and lifecycle risks are proactively governed and reduced through effective standards, controls and investment planning. Enterprise technology teams and operational stakeholders execute against integrated roadmaps with clear accountability, priorities and measurable outcomes. Desired Candidate Profile Minimum Qualifications Master s degree in Electrical, Control, Industrial or Systems Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience 10 15 years of relevant experience in operational technology, industrial automation, infrastructure or industrial technology environments. Significant experience leading enterprise-scale OT modernization, systems integration, connectivity or cloud and edge transformation. Strong experience with industrial environments incorporating SCADA, DCS, PLC, MES, LIMS, historians and networked production technologies. Demonstrated leadership of multidisciplinary technical teams and complex transformation initiatives across enterprise and operational environments. Skills That Matter Enterprise OT architecture and industrial automation Cloud, edge, hosting and industrial connectivity OT/IT convergence and systems integration Industrial control and production systems OT cybersecurity, resilience and technology risk Technology strategy and transformation roadmaps Operational performance and lifecycle management Large-scale modernization and program delivery Executive stakeholder and vendor management People leadership and capability building

e395368f46ce6a5f.description: Who We Are Pronto AI is a global leader in commercializing autonomous vehicle (AV) technology, deploying Autonomous Haulage Systems (AHS) that automate operations in mines, quarries, and construction sites worldwide. While much of the industry remains in R&D, we deliver real, production-ready autonomy that is already operating in the field. We are on a mission to make mining operations safer, smarter, and more efficient through cutting-edge technology, and we are building toward becoming the world’s first profitable AV technology company. What You’ll Do The Field Engineer is a hands-on role, responsible for the installation, preventive maintenance, and repair of Pronto's advanced technology solutions across a range of customer locations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring successful deployment and optimal performance of Pronto equipment in the field. Installation & Deployment Electrical and mechanical Scoping of Construction and Mining equipment Perform on-site installation of Pronto hardware and software solutions, including sensor systems, DBW kits, power integration, and vehicle interfaces. On site installation of peripheral hardware such as network stations, gate systems and office infrastructure. Conduct system calibrations and validation tests to ensure installations meet operational standards. Collaborate with Engineering and Customer teams to ensure field deployments align with specifications and best practices. Collaborate with engineering on R&D projects Coordinate with customer teams on training and technical maintenance Preventive Maintenance Carry out scheduled maintenance tasks to ensure system health, reliability, and long-term performance. Monitor and log equipment conditions, identifying signs of wear, degradation, or environmental impacts. Troubleshooting & Repair Diagnose and repair hardware, software, and connectivity issues in the field. Utilize diagnostic tools and logs to identify root causes and implement fixes with minimal downtime. Communicate findings clearly to engineering teams for deeper analysis and continuous improvement. Customer Support Serve as the face of Pronto during on-site visits, maintaining professional and responsive communication with customer personnel. Provide basic training to customer staff when required. Document all service activities, updates, and issues using internal ticketing and CRM tools. What We’re Looking For Advanced degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Systems Engineering or other relevant discipline 5+ years of experience in field service, automotive electronics, mechatronics, or a similar technical support role. Proficiency with hand tools, diagnostic equipment, and electrical testing tools. Solid understanding of vehicle systems (power, CAN bus, sensors, ECUs). Ability to read wiring diagrams, schematics, and follow technical documentation. Comfortable working independently in field environments and with minimal supervision. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Willingness to travel up to 75% to customer sites. Preferred Experience with autonomous vehicle systems, heavy equipment, machine control, robotics, or complex sensor integrations. Familiarity with Linux-based systems and remote diagnostics. OSHA 10 or equivalent safety certification. Physical Requirements Ability to lift up to 50 pounds. Capable of standing, bending, and working in and around vehicles for extended periods. Comfortable working outdoors in varying weather conditions. Why join us Work on real, production-deployed autonomy. Build technology that directly improves safety, efficiency, and productivity. Tackle complex challenges in demanding, real-world environments. Be part of a fast-moving team with high ownership and impact. See your work deployed and making a difference in the field. Collaborate closely with experienced engineers and industry operators. What Else You Need To Know This is a field-based role supporting operations across the Middle East. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change—we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. This position requires travel across the Middle East. up to 75% of the time. Candidates should be comfortable with frequent travel and a highly mobile work environment. Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

e3f6f0f2dc257c74.description: Our Vision, we make moments M venpick Hotels & Residences (MH&R) is in the moments business. We re intimately involved in important times in our guests lives. And you never know when a moment can be made. A simple smile in the lobby can create the positivity that turns a business trip into a new business celebration. An insider tip on the best way to spend a day can make an entire holiday. A romantic dinner for two can lead to a longer-term partnership. It doesn t take much to create a moment just be genuine, human, and warm. Take small steps to turn the ordinary into something extraordinary We understand that this vision cannot be achieved without great people who create and support work environments designed to produce exceptional results. The Role 1. To oversee and lead the Banquet department of the Hotel. 2. Banquet Manager is responsible for the smooth operation of his/her specific Event as governed by contract and deemed by operational requirements. 3. He or she must be fully responsible for the daily operation and maintenance of banquet FF&E and OSE, as well as for organizing storage areas and ensuring cleanliness. 4. He/she is responsible in linking all facets of cuisine and entertainment and then delivering these to guests. 5. He/she must be able to control and coordinate a labour pool of many and varied backgrounds. 6. He/she will have a majority of casual labour and hence it is essential to have quality staff management skills. 7. Should be creative and confident and be prepared to step outside of the confines of comfort. 8. He/she should take the time to get to know the guests and be committed to service excellence. 9. Team play is imperative and having the time to invest in self-development is mandatory. 10. Being entrepreneurial, thinking beyond the boundaries and leading by example are expected and not requested. Key Deliverables and Responsibilities Planning & Organizing: 1. Ensure that all M venpick Hotels & Residences standards are adhered. 2. He/she must check the daily casual staff's grooming standards and verify their Ajeer permits and iqamas on a daily basis without fail (if the Ajeer permits and iqamas are not available, the concerned casual staff must be sent back to the company immediately without fail). 3. Be innovative at all the time. 4. Keep ahead of industry trends (you should set the trends rather than follow) 5. Develop ideas on increasing guest satisfaction. 6. The role is to uphold the Movenpick service standard and manage daily in-house and ODC events. Operations: 1. Leads the daily and weekly meeting. 2. Train and develop the Banquet team in the departmental operating standards. 3. Maintains a presence during events including outside catering events. 4. Maintain a consistent focus on improving the overall flow of Banquet operations. 5. To lead and support employees in the achievement of financial, operational and service delivery targets via effective organizational policy and procedural development and appropriate employee training activities. 6. Foster a winning, solution-oriented work environment, motivating and engaging employees to continuously deliver the best possible service and to provide feedback and suggestions. 7. Source and audition entertainment and decorative options suitable for Banquets and Events. 8. Maintain awareness of industry trends and share with the team. 9. Review, analyse market and competition changes and implement proactive action plans to meet these changes in cooperation with Banquet manager and approved by Director of F&B. 10. Ensure organizers are communicated with and assisted in an efficient, warm and professional manner by all team members. 11. Actively review organizer and guest comments and feedback, communicate this with the team members and implement procedures to enhance guest satisfaction 12. To ensure a consistently high standard of grooming is followed and the team. 13. To have a complete understanding of and to adhere to M venpick Hotels & Residences policy relating to Fire, Hygiene, Health and Safety. 14. To drive the performance of the Banquet team members, including completion of performance appraisals, coaching counselling and performance management in conjunction with Human Resources. 15. Have full knowledge of all products and services provided by the property and in the local area. 16. Assume the responsibility of daily banquet operations. 17. Maintain appropriate staffing levels on the banquet floor. 18. Following up on opening and closing checklists on daily basis. 19. Ensure all appropriate equipment is on hand for each service period. 20. Ensure all the storages are well maintain and organize. 21. Ensures that the correct ordering and billing procedures are in place and that all cash handling is carried out correctly. This includes overseeing and checking the cashier and floats at the conclusion of the event and all banking done (specially banquet event order must be carefully monitored prier closing the bills) 22. All the banquet event orders (BEO) must be clearly studied and communicate with entire banquet team and concern departments. 23. Conducts daily briefings and training for all staff prior to commencement of shift, providing such information as service requirements, sequence and preparation for the day 24. Must be capable of handling security incidents, guest complaints or queries with confidence and in a professional manner. 25. Directly work with F&B director and all banquet employees to create a flow of new and improved ideas. 26. Ensure awareness and deliver the optimum levels of service and guest satisfaction 27. Attaining and maintaining the sanitation (HACCP or similar) certificates as required by the regional governing body. 28. Ensure all hotel property and facilities are maintained an in an optimal working order. 29. Take full ownership and responsibility for any issues that may occur in the department. 30. Ensure rooms/events is set prior to the commencement of service. 31. Master all POS systems 32. To carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned. Administration: 1. Establish and maintain effective employee relationships. 2. Implement training plans to further develop self and subordinate outlet employees. 3. Lead by example through a passionate, hands on approach. 4. Maintaining all outlet records. 5. Maintain and submit the month-end banquet operations report, including casual and permanent attendance, AV rental details. 6. Evaluate an employee s performance in staff appraisals, with a focus on adherence to procedures and departmental standards.

Solid knowledge of end-user computing environments, including Windows, Microsoft 365, hardware, printers, peripherals, and basic networking . Experience managing onsite or field-based technical support operations. Experience delivering knowledge-transfer sessions, technical workshops, or user training. Strong understanding of incident management, service requests, escalation management, knowledge management, and continuous improvement. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and presentation skills. Strong customer-service mindset with a high level of empathy and professionalism. Ability to lead and coordinate technical teams and influence stakeholders across different functions. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Comfortable working in dynamic, operational, and user-facing environments. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology , or a related field. 6+ years of experience across IT Service Management, Service Desk, End User Support, or related IT support operations. At least 3 years of experience in a leadership or supervisory role within IT support or service operations. Experience leading Service Desk and End User Support teams is highly preferred. ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent is an advantage. Ideal Candidate Profile A strong candidate will combine Service Desk leadership with hands-on knowledge of End User Support and IT Service Management . They should have experience managing user-facing support operations and be comfortable handling service escalations, SLA performance, ITSM processes, stakeholder engagement, end-user experience, and continuous improvement . The ideal candidate will have a strong customer-service mindset while maintaining enough technical understanding to effectively coordinate support teams, challenge recurring issues, and drive improvements in service quality and user satisfaction.

e30979e2bbf70253.description: At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, empowering thousands of merchants to start, grow, and scale their businesses. e326726f5a4da440.description: About Foodics Foodics, established in 2014, is a restaurant management ecosystem and payment technology provider headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. With offices in five countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan, and Kuwait, Foodics serves customers and partners in over 35 countries globally. The company's products have processed over 6 billion orders, positioning Foodics as a rapidly evolving SaaS company in the MENA region. Foodics has secured three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million, enhancing its innovation capabilities to support business owners. The Role of AI Engineer Foodics is seeking an AI Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time position involves constructing agentic AI architecture, leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. Working within a compact engineering team, the AI Engineer will build core foundational infrastructure, including microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and evaluation harnesses, ensuring systems are production-ready, reliable, and scalable. This is a hands-on backend software engineering role focused on coding, testing, and system diagnostics. While prompt design is part of the workflow, complex architectural challenges are primarily within the underlying infrastructure. The company welcomes applicants across diverse seniority levels, with final placement determined by candidate capability, given that production-grade agentic engineering is an emerging discipline. Opportunities are available for early-career developers through veteran software architects, with engineering excellence mandatory at all levels. Junior engineers will pair with senior mentors to own production components within three months, while senior engineers will drive technical standards and architectural vision. Key Responsibilities Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces. Design robust tool integrations and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers. Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions, adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards. Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and systematically capture production edge cases. Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency. Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers. Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization. Technical Standards and Architecture The engineering environment at Foodics adheres to industry standards and operational frameworks, with continuous learning integrated into the engineering onboarding process. Key standards include: Model Context Protocol (MCP): An open standard managed via the Linux Foundation for integrating models with tool services and data stores. OpenTelemetry GenAI Conventions: Standardized instrumentation schemas for tracking model execution traces, step transitions, and tool invocations. OWASP GenAI & Agentic Security Guidelines: Threat modeling standards emphasizing containment strategies, least-privilege tooling, strict input sanitization, and authorization gates for critical actions. Eval-Driven Development: Mandatory evaluation validation prior to shipping behavioral changes, relying on internal domain-specific test harnesses rather than external benchmark metrics. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess strong backend software engineering skills. The following areas are considered out of scope for this role: Extensive experience with specific agent frameworks, given the nascent nature of the ecosystem. Academic AI research background, specialized ML degrees, or mathematical derivation of backpropagation. Deep expertise in base model training or fine-tuning workflows. Flawless portfolio presentations; emphasis is placed on technical depth and problem-solving reasoning. Strictly conventional career trajectories; non-traditional and self-taught engineering backgrounds are evaluated equally. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. The company values technical depth and problem-solving reasoning in its evaluation process.

e32d3e1e62c36248.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث فرع شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية من مرحلة الدراسة الأولية وحتى التنفيذ، مع ضمان مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع لتحديد الجدوى والتوافق. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية للمشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية لضمان الدقة والامتثال. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع في الموقع ومطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل الهندسية ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف والتنسيق الميداني. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية والجودة. بيئة العمل يتطلب هذا الدور العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تنفيذ المشاريع الإنشائية بكفاءة عالية. تقديم الطلبات الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للانضمام إلى فريق فرع شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل.

e3c3ea6d95a88737.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة طرق الجزيره للمباني والطرق عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى المساهمة في متابعة وتنفيذ الأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، ويوفر فرصة لاكتساب الخبرة العملية والتطوير المهني في بيئة عمل متخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساعدة في متابعة الأعمال المدنية للمشاريع وضمان تنفيذها وفق المخططات والمواصفات المعتمدة. مراجعة المخططات والرسومات الهندسية والمساهمة في التنسيق بين الأطراف المعنية. متابعة تقدم الأعمال وإعداد التقارير الدورية عن سير المشروع. المساعدة في حصر الكميات وإعداد ومراجعة المستندات الفنية. التنسيق مع المقاولين والاستشاريين وفرق العمل في الموقع. ضمان الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة في جميع الأعمال التنفيذية. المشاركة في حل المشكلات الفنية وتقديم الدعم الهندسي عند الحاجة. تنفيذ المهام الأخرى ذات الصلة التي يتم تكليفها من الإدارة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الهندسية. مهارات تواصل وتنسيق فعالة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة طرق الجزيره للمباني والطرق، في وظيفة بدوام كامل بالمنطقة الشرقية. تتيح الشركة بيئة داعمة للتطوير المهني واكتساب الخبرات العملية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

e3cbdf559e885827.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث فندق لمار أجياد الأول عن أخصائي مراقبة موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة الممارسات المتخصصة في مجال مراقبة الموارد البشرية، وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بهذا المجال وحفظها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل التجارب والممارسات الدولية في مجال مراقبة الموارد البشرية، وتقييم إمكانية الاستفادة منها أو جدوى تطبيقها. تقديم التوصيات والمقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب والممارسات الحديثة والمناسبة في مراقبة الموارد البشرية. دراسة وتحليل عمليات الموارد البشرية المنفذة، مثل التقيد بالمتطلبات الوظيفية عند التوظيف، وعمليات النقل والترقيات. تقييم عمليات الموارد البشرية بالتنسيق مع إدارات الموارد البشرية والوحدات التنظيمية المعنية. تحليل ومراجعة عمليات الموارد البشرية لضمان مطابقتها للأنظمة واللوائح والإجراءات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة، ومواكبة التطورات والمستجدات في مجال مراقبة الموارد البشرية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بمراقبة الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة بمراقبة الموارد البشرية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الممارسات المتخصصة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم العمليات والممارسات. القدرة على تطوير الإجراءات ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد التقارير وحفظ البيانات. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في مكة المكرمة، وتعتبر الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق فندق لمار أجياد الأول. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

e3cc012c46d0ad97.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة ومراقبة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تشخيص المشكلات الفنية وإيجاد الحلول المناسبة لها. تحديد المخططات التفصيلية، وتقدير كميات المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين المشاركين في أعمال تركيب المعدات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة الكهربائية بعد تركيبها لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات الأولية والمواصفات الفنية المطلوبة. الصيانة وتشخيص الأعطال القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية كجزء من أعمال الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الكهربائية. تشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل في الأنظمة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة لتحديد المكونات التالفة. إصلاح أو استبدال المكونات التالفة لضمان استمرارية عمل الأنظمة. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو الصيانة الكهربائية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الهندسة الكهربائية ضمن فريق متخصص في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، في وظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

e3e87c810f3d4040.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Transport & Mobility Engineer to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves contributing to and supporting various traffic engineering, corridor assessment, and mobility improvement activities across the city. The engineer will utilize field observations, traffic data, analytical tools, and engineering judgment to develop practical transportation solutions. Role Context and Development This position offers significant development opportunities for an engineer interested in large-city traffic management and operational improvement. The successful candidate will collaborate with experienced traffic engineers, transportation planners, civil engineers, ITS specialists, and RCRC counterparts. The work focuses on assessing road network performance, investigating congestion and safety concerns, and developing implementable improvement concepts for Riyadh's transportation infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Support traffic engineering and mobility assessments at intersections, corridors, highways, access points, public transport interfaces, and congestion hotspots across Riyadh. Review various traffic data, including counts, turning movements, travel times, queue observations, speed data, crash information, and video, to identify operational deficiencies. Conduct field inspections to document existing traffic operations, geometric constraints, lane-use issues, pedestrian conditions, access conflicts, and parking impacts. Develop and review practical traffic management and geometric improvement concepts, such as lane-use changes, turn-lane modifications, access management, signing and marking improvements, signal-timing changes, intersection channelization, and localized capacity improvements. Support corridor assessments by identifying recurring bottlenecks, progression issues, queue spillback, operational conflicts, and opportunities for multimodal improvements. Prepare technical sketches, exhibits, maps, photographs, calculations, tables, and engineering narratives to explain observed issues and recommended treatments. Support senior engineers with analytical tasks using Synchro, GIS, spreadsheets, or other tools to test and compare transportation improvement options. Support before-and-after evaluations and the development of performance measures for implemented traffic improvements. Coordinate with roadway, signal, ITS, public transport, parking, safety, and construction specialists to ensure recommendations account for wider network impacts. Assist with the preparation of assessment reports, corridor studies, presentations, technical memoranda, guidelines, and implementation recommendations. Participate in site meetings, technical workshops, and coordination sessions with RCRC and other project stakeholders. Maintain organized engineering records, ensuring analysis inputs, assumptions, field observations, and recommendations are traceable. Apply current transportation engineering practices while seeking innovative, data-driven solutions appropriate for Riyadh’s operating environment. Support implementation monitoring and field verification to determine whether completed improvements are functioning as intended. Develop technical capability through mentoring, structured review, and exposure to traffic operations, transportation planning, ITS, and roadway design disciplines. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in transport and mobility engineering. The role requires a strong understanding of traffic engineering principles and analytical tools, coupled with practical experience in assessing and improving transportation networks. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a collaborative team environment, engaging with various specialists and stakeholders to deliver comprehensive transportation solutions. About Parsons Parsons is a global company focused on delivering innovative solutions. The company values its people, embraces agility, and fosters growth, cultivating an innovative culture that empowers employees to achieve their full potential.

e328413bcbbff1de.description: About the Role Al-Futtaim is seeking a Marketing Executive for FAMCO Saudi Arabia. This full-time role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across the Commercial Vehicles, Construction Equipment, Material Handling, and Industrial Solutions businesses. The position focuses on driving brand awareness, lead generation, customer engagement, and campaign effectiveness through both digital and traditional marketing channels within Saudi Arabia. Role Context and Collaboration The Marketing Executive will work closely with sales teams, product managers, external agencies, and key stakeholders. The primary objective is to deliver impactful marketing campaigns that support business objectives and contribute to revenue growth across the Kingdom. This role operates within a collaborative and fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Plan, coordinate, and execute marketing campaigns across digital, social media, email, events, and offline channels. Develop engaging marketing content, including brochures, presentations, social media posts, videos, customer success stories, and promotional materials. Support lead generation activities and collaborate with sales teams to convert marketing opportunities into business results. Manage and update website content, digital assets, and marketing collateral. Coordinate participation in exhibitions, trade shows, customer events, and product launches. Monitor and analyze campaign performance, preparing reports and recommendations for continuous improvement. Conduct market research to identify industry trends, customer needs, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities. Manage relationships with advertising agencies, media partners, printers, and other external vendors. Ensure brand consistency across all marketing communications and customer touchpoints. Assist in the preparation and management of marketing budgets and campaign expenditure. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in marketing. Work Environment This role is part of a collaborative and fast-paced team that emphasizes innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement. It offers exposure to multiple business segments within one of the region's industrial equipment providers.

e321b8487668a115.description: The Fire Safety Engineer is responsible for delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities across KAUST under the direction of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. The role supports KAUST's delegated Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) governance framework by conducting technical reviews, field assessments, inspections, compliance verification, fire risk assessments, and technical investigations within approved KAUST procedures and delegated authorities. The role prepares technical recommendations for review and approval through the Lead, Fire Safety Engineer and the Health and Safety Manager, as applicable. The Fire Safety Engineer also supports compliance with Saudi Civil Defense requirements, Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements by maintaining audit-ready evidence, verifying fire protection system performance, supporting Civil Defense-related documentation and inspections where applicable, and escalating significant fire and life safety risks. Responsibilities Conduct fire and life safety engineering reviews, assessments, inspections, and field verifications. Review fire safety requirements for new construction, renovations, research facilities, high-hazard areas, and fire protection systems. Ensure compliance with SBC, NFPA, IFC, KAUST requirements, and Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Conduct fire risk assessments, inspections, system verification, and compliance checks, and recommend corrective actions. Review and maintain fire safety documentation, drawings, test certificates, inspection records, ITM records, and deficiency closure evidence. Coordinate with Projects, Facilities, contractors, consultants, Fire & Emergency Services, and other stakeholders to resolve fire safety issues. Provide technical assurance for Inspection, Testing & Maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems and monitor corrective actions. Participate in testing, commissioning, acceptance, and functional verification of fire alarms, suppression systems, smoke control, passive fire protection, fire doors, barriers, and egress systems. Support investigations of fire incidents, unwanted alarms, system failures, and impairments, including root cause analysis and corrective actions. Bachelor's degree in Fire Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 6 years of professional experience in fire protection engineering, fire systems engineering, fire prevention, or fire & life safety compliance. Experience with fire protection system inspection, testing, commissioning, and compliance. Strong knowledge of SBC, NFPA, IFC, and preferably Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Experience reviewing fire protection designs, technical drawings, specifications, inspection reports, testing documents, and compliance records. Experience with deficiency management, corrective actions, and closeout. Experience working in complex environments such as universities, research facilities, industrial facilities, healthcare, mixed-use communities, or large campuses. Valid Saudi/GCC driver's license or valid driver's license as applicable. Fire safety/protection certifications such as CFPS, CFPE, CFAITMS, CWBSP, NICET, IFE, or equivalent are preferred.

e327c1abd1bed64b.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تعلن شركة التحلية الذكية عن توفر شاغر وظيفي لموظفة سعودية في مجال خدمة العملاء ومركز الاتصال (الكول سنتر) بمدينة الرياض. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل بنظام حضوري، وتهدف إلى تقديم دعم احترافي للعملاء وضمان رضاهم عن الخدمات المقدمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال المكالمات الواردة والرد على استفسارات العملاء بمهنية عالية. تقديم المعلومات الوافية حول الخدمات وتوضيح الإجراءات المطلوبة للعملاء. متابعة طلبات العملاء وشكواهم، والعمل على حلها أو تحويلها إلى الأقسام المختصة. إجراء المكالمات الهاتفية الصادرة للعملاء عند الضرورة. تسجيل وتحديث بيانات العملاء والملاحظات المتعلقة بهم في النظام المخصص. متابعة رضا العملاء عن مستوى الخدمة المقدمة. الالتزام التام بسياسات وإجراءات خدمة العملاء المعتمدة في الشركة. إعداد التقارير اليومية ومتابعة مؤشرات الأداء الخاصة بالعمل. التعاون الفعال مع فريق العمل لتحقيق الأهداف العامة لخدمة العملاء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة يشترط أن تكون المتقدمة سعودية الجنسية. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مراكز الاتصال. القدرة على التواصل بفعالية وتقديم الدعم للعملاء. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بنظام الدوام الكامل الحضوري في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص في خدمة العملاء. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير مهارات الموظفات. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المتقدمات اللواتي تتوافر فيهن الشروط المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة الوظيفية في شركة التحلية الذكية.

e3dbc34fe370ddde.description: Description HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking a skilled Document Control Manager to manage and oversee the document control functions for our projects. Manage receipt, classification, distribution, and filing of all relevant project documents. Coordinate with internal teams, clients, subcontractors, and suppliers to ensure accurate and timely documentation. Maintain document registers and control logs to track status and revisions. Ensure compliance with quality standards, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements. Supervise and train document control staff in maintaining documentation standards. Support audits and inspections by providing necessary documentation promptly. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related discipline. At least 10 years’ experience in document control management, preferably within construction, engineering, or infrastructure sectors.
